notes.title: Update v1.0.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the game to lock the player in a cutscene after pressing the pause button rapidly in succession when starting the cutscene;
[*] Added some direction indicators to one of the puzzle hints.
[/list]

notes.title: Thank you for playing, consider leaving a review!
notes.content:
First of all, I would like to show my gratitude for everyone who bought the game, so thank you all very much <3. I'm really happy to see people from several places in the world playing and having fun with the game I have created. I hope it was a great experience for all!

If you enjoyed the game, consider leaving a review on the store page! This way, the game can get to more people!

notes.title: Tetradome is OUT NOW!!!
notes.content: Do you have what it takes to escape the Dome and the 4 elements of nature? Tetradome just released on Steam! I really hope you all can enjoy the game; it was done with a lot of care, and don't forget to leave a review after playing! Thank you all for giving my game a chance <3.

notes.title: Release date reveal!
notes.content:
After 10 months of work, Tetradome is finally ready and will release next Friday, March 7th, 2025!!! The game will be available on the Steam store for Windows systems at 03:00 PM PST.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/10JWbsI.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank you for 100 whishlists!!!
notes.content:
